description: Java source code for AcknowledgementsAdapter class, which maps Acknowledgements objects to and from Adaptable instances within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for converting between Acknowledgements objects and Adaptable instances, handling JSON serialization/deserialization and header translation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of AcknowledgementsAdapter with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into an Acknowledgements instance by extracting payload and headers.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Acknowledgements object into an Adaptable instance with appropriate topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath groups this adapter is associated with (THINGS).

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath channels (TWIN, LIVE).

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria (ACKS) for this adapter.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set, indicating no specific actions.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is used for responses.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter does not require a subject.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Builds the topic path for acknowledgements based on entity ID and channel.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Creates a Payload object from acknowledgements, including status and JSON value.

methods.name: getPayloadValue
methods.description: Serializes acknowledgements into a JSON object.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutLabel
methods.description: Converts an Acknowledgement to JSON, excluding the label.

methods.name: getExternalHeaders
methods.description: Translates internal headers to external headers, ensuring Content-Type is set.
